goal: Prevent creating wallets whose names consist entirely of whitespace characters
Avoids creating confusing or indistinguishable directory paths on the filesystem
agreement: Support for rejecting whitespace-only names on creation while keeping existing ones loadable (achow101)
Nonblocking objection: disallow leading or trailing whitespace too and fix inaccurate error text (polespinasa)
Resolved concern that pre-existing whitespace wallet names might fail to load (maflcko)

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because whitespace-only wallet creation is a minor edge case with narrow practical impact
Benefit is limited to input validation preventing confusing directory names on disk
